headline: Zillow to Pay $212.5 Million to Settle Class Action Over Real Estate Venture
summary: Zillow agreed to pay $212.5 million to settle a class action lawsuit stemming from a failed real estate venture.
why: Zillow Group is a major digital real estate marketplace platform, and large legal settlements can materially impact its quarterly financial results and cash reserves.

impacts.name: Zillow Group Inc
impacts.why: A substantial settlement payment represents a direct cash outflow that affects the company's net income.

why_moved: The resolution of a multi-million-dollar class action creates a significant one-off financial charge for the firm.
